Service: 1,000eb. A Medtech's materials: 500eb (Expensive), DV15 Medical Tech. On a success the patient gains the therapy's effect (CP:R p.229).

In the 2070s, therapy is sold only behind health plans: REO offers Addiction Therapy, Trauma Team Silver and Executive offer Standard and Addiction. A Medtech can provide it at the listed DV and costs; materials come only from Biotechnica. A failed check wastes the week and the materials. Prices assume the patient doesn't stay overnight (100eb a night if they do, even with a private Medtech). Medtechs can't treat themselves.
